description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to user session management, including tenant listing, setting active tenant, and toggling super admin modes. It handles authentication, authorization, audit logging, and setting cookies for tenant context.

methods.name: router.get('/tenants')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tenants accessible to the authenticated user, including audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenant')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set the active tenant in session, with RBAC checks, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenants/select')
methods.description: Alias route to select tenant, reusing the /tenant logic.

methods.name: router.post('/all-tenants')
methods.description: Handles toggling of super admin global mode for the session, setting headers and audit logging.
